# Faisal E Connect — CSC Common Service Centre

> Faisal E Connect is a government-authorised Common Service Centre (CSC ID: 264245130018) located in Garden Reach, Kolkata, West Bengal (Pincode: 700024). It provides 22+ digital, citizen, financial, travel, and document printing services under one roof.

## Offered Services (22 Services Under One Roof)

### 1. Identity & Government Documents
- **Aadhar Card (New Enrollment & Correction)**: Name, address, date of birth, mobile number update, and biometric corrections.
- **PAN Card (New Application & Correction)**: Instant e-PAN, physical PAN card, minor-to-major updates, and name/DOB corrections.
- **Voter ID Card (New Registration & Correction)**: Form 6 (New Voter), Form 8 (Correction & Address Change), Epic download.
- **Ration Card (Digital Ration Card Services)**: New application, name addition/deletion, category change, and Aadhaar linking.
- **Birth Certificate**: Online application assistance, correction, and verification.
- **e-Shram Card Registration**: New unorganized worker registration, card download, and profile update.
- **Affidavit Assistance (1st Class Magistrate)**: Name change affidavits, DOB correction, relationship proof, and legal stamp documentation.

### 2. Travel & Transport Services
- **Passport Services (New Application & Renewal)**: Fresh normal/Tatkaal passport application, renewal of expired passports, document upload, and appointment scheduling at PSK/POPSK.
- **Driving Licence Assistance**: Learner's licence (LL), permanent driving licence (DL), DL renewal, and address change.
- **Train Ticket Booking (IRCTC Authorised)**: Confirmed train reservation, Tatkal ticket booking, cancellation, and PNR status check.
- **Flight Ticket Booking**: Domestic and international flight ticket reservations.

### 3. Education & Form Fill Up
- **School & College Admission Form Fill Up**: Online college registration, university forms, and entrance exam submissions.
- **Scholarship Form Fill Up**: SVMCM (Swami Vivekananda Scholarship), Oasis, Aikyashree, National Scholarship Portal (NSP), and Kanyashree documentation.
- **Project Photos & Documentation**: Educational school/college project printouts, diagrams, and formatting.

### 4. Digital & Financial Services (AEPS & Banking)
- **AEPS Cash Withdrawal (Aadhaar Enabled Payment System)**: Biometric fingerprint-based cash withdrawal from any Indian bank account.
- **Domestic Money Transfer (DMT)**: Instant IMPS / NEFT fund transfer to any bank in India.
- **Mobile & DTH Recharge**: Prepaid/postpaid recharge for Jio, Airtel, Vi, BSNL, Tata Play, Airtel DTH, Sun Direct, and Dish TV.
- **Electricity Bill Payment**: Instant CESC, WBSEDCL, and other electricity board bill payments with printed receipts.
- **Pension Payment Withdrawal**: Old age pension, widow pension, and disability pension disbursements.

### 5. Printing & Photo Services
- **Passport Size Photo**: Instant studio-quality passport size photos with clean blue/white background.
- **Black & White & Color Printout**: Document printing, government circulars, and PDF printouts.
- **Photocopy / Xerox**: High-speed black & white and color photocopying.
- **Lamination**: Thermal lamination for Aadhaar cards, PAN cards, marks cards, and certificates.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Is Faisal E Connect a verified Government CSC?
Yes. Faisal E Connect is a registered and authorised Common Service Centre under the Digital India Initiative with official CSC ID: 264245130018.

### How can customers book an appointment or send documents?
Customers can message directly on WhatsApp at **+91 9007140591** to inquire about required documents, processing fees, and turnaround times before visiting the counter.

### What are the payment methods accepted?
Cash, UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), and Net Banking.
